output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes two issues: (1) minute validation in parse_hhmm, and (2) proper round-half-up rounding. However, it adds unexplained logic to subtract 12 minutes whenever an entry has exactly 30 minutes. This logic makes test_overtime_half_hour pass but contradicts the docstring, which describes no special handling for 30-minute entries. This appears to be test-specific logic rather than a genuine fix. Before merging, clarify with the teammate whether this 12-minute adjustment is actually part of the payroll spec, or if the test itself needs correction.
